default.description: Local-only capability for the setup wizard and splash windows. The privileged `default` command set (wizard, Drive, sync, tray and destructive path commands) must never be granted to the sidecar origin: the main WebView has its own minimal capability in main.json (#2688). No remote origin is listed here — the wizard runs on tauri://localhost / https://tauri.localhost.

gblite-window-controls.description: Window controls for the page-drawn header: drag, minimise, toggle-maximise, close and maximise state query. Granted to the sidecar origin so the remote page can drive the undecorated window. The permissions are harmless window-chrome operations; the window itself is only undecorated in gblite builds.

main.description: Least-privilege capability for the main WebView. It is navigated to the loopback sidecar, whose HTML/JS may include model-generated content, so it receives only core window commands and the few read-only/download commands the suite actually calls. All wizard, Drive, sync, tray and destructive commands stay on the local-only wizard capability (#2688).

mobile.description: Thin-client capability set for Android and iOS. Local bundled UI only, remote botserver reached over HTTPS/WSS from the WebView. No filesystem provider, no dialog, notification or geolocation plugin, and no sidecar commands.
